articles.body: Mississippi voted blue, in a shock win for Democrats. Democrat Scott Colom ousted Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in a state that went for President Donald Trump by 23 points in 2024. He will be the first Black senator elected in Mississippi since the Reconstruction era — and the first Democrat from the state headed to the Senate in 44 years. Colom, a Democratic district attorney, ran a scrappy campaign that saw some national money and resources in the final stretch of the race. Hyde-Smith was appointed to the Senate in 2018 and had since won election to the seat twice, but she faced attacks from Colom that she was out of touch and indifferent to rising grocery and gas prices during Trump’s second term. National Democratic groups hadn't paid much attention to the Mississippi Senate race until an October surge of excitement for Colom drew late spending and attention. Colom's win is a boost to the Democratic Party as it seeks to gain a larger foothold in the South and improve their standing with Black voters. It’s also a major vindication for Colom and other Southern Democrats who argued Mississippi had been neglected for far too long.
articles.headline: Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom to Senate in massive upset

articles.body: A growing number of Republicans on Capitol Hill want to draft Marco Rubio for a 2028 presidential bid as they grapple with their midterms wipeout — and look beyond Vice President JD Vance. The generational losses are sparking new discussions among Hill Republicans about who should lead the party. Many argue the race to carry the mantle is now wide open — including a faction who view Rubio as a better fit, given that voters may continue to tie Vance to the president’s unpopularity, interviews with roughly two dozen GOP lawmakers reveal. “I hope he runs. I think he's the best person to communicate, to unify,” Rep. Marlin Stutzman (R-Ind.) said of Rubio in an interview. “I think he's the most talented Republican by far,” Stutzman said when asked about why he supported the secretary of State over Vance. “We're going to have to continue to re-message, put some new faces up.” The vice president still has his supporters. And he got a boost Tuesday by fellow Ohio Republican Jim Jordan being elected as the incoming House minority leader. But the election wipeout “certainly makes it harder for Vance,” said one GOP senator, who like others in this article, was granted anonymity to speak candidly. “I think Rubio is our best hope to lead Republicans out of this wilderness, and I hope he makes his break from Trump and JD early next year,” said one House Republican in the wake of the election. The openness toward Rubio — or any other candidate that’s not Vance — is a complication for the vice president, who was picked by Trump for the role that’s next in line to the presidency. Now, Vance has to grapple with being closely associated with an agenda that even GOP lawmakers argue voters harshly rebuked last week. Several lawmakers said they’ve spoken to people close to Rubio who have suggested he isn’t interested in pursuing a 2028 bid, even after Tuesday’s results. Rubio himself this week has stood by Trump’s decision to go to war against Iran and told reporters Monday he was “just not going to talk about 2028 anymore.” A person close to Rubio said the secretary of State is the only person who knows what he will do regarding a presidential bid. Right now, he’s “fully focused on doing his many jobs and isn’t thinking about 2028.” But some Hill Republicans aren’t giving up hope. “I’m a big supporter of Marco Rubio, and I’m very excited about the potential of his candidacy,” said Florida Rep. Mike Haridopolos, who has known the secretary of State for nearly three decades. “No question he’s ready to be president if he chooses to pursue the office.” “Some of us are still hoping we can draft Marco,” said another GOP senator. A State Department spokesperson declined to comment. Vance’s office didn’t respond to a request for comment. In reaction to Stutzman’s comments, a Vance ally argued that Stutzman has been one of the biggest supporters within the GOP of amnesty for unauthorized immigrants for over a decade — and that he was likely never going to support Vance, who is extremely hawkish on border security. Vance, for his part, has tried to distance himself from the unpopular Iran war, blaming it for the party’s losses in the immediate aftermath of the midterm election. His allies argue that the vice president would’ve always faced some internal opposition, like Trump did within the GOP ahead of the 2016 election. However, as the Rubio talk swirls, even some of Trump’s top MAGA allies on Capitol Hill are unwilling to publicly declare Vance the presumptive GOP nominee for 2028. “Can I skip this one?” one House GOP hardliner said. “Not wading into 2028 yet.” Some Republican senators also declined to back Vance just yet, citing their own reelections. GOP Rep. and Sen.-elect Barry Moore of Alabama said he thought Vance would certainly “have a shot” at the presidency in 2028. Moore was the first member of Congress to back Trump for the 2016 race. But Moore for now is leaving his endorsement up in the air: “We got a great bench," he said. "Whoever steps up, we'll be happy to support.” Rubio’s supporters say that he’s not as closely associated with the 2026 GOP wipeout as Vance, but he could face his own obstacles. Rubio, unlike Vance, has continued to show strong support for the war in Iran, a conflict he’s tied to as the country’s top diplomat. Some GOP lawmakers have also grown frustrated with the amount of information the Trump administration, including Rubio at times, has been willing to share about the ongoing conflict. Rubio also has his failed 2016 presidential run to contend with, including an infamous debate performance where he awkwardly repeated the same rehearsed line multiple times. One thing is clear, the 2028 presidential race is now wide open, many Hill Republicans argue as they process Tuesday’s results. And other potential candidates only appear encouraged after the midterms wipeout. Several Hill Republicans believe outgoing Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, who has been one of the most outspoken Republicans urging a course correction after the midterms bloodbath, will get in the race as well. Sen. Josh Hawley (R-Mo.) this week also didn’t rule out a presidential bid. Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas) also appears likely to run. “I think everybody reserves the right to adjust. You know, learn from this,” GOP Rep. and incoming Oklahoma Sen. Kevin Hern said. Asked his favorite candidate of the three he expected to run: Vance, Rubio or DeSantis, he replied with a smile: “Everybody.” Vance does have ardent supporters, including Sen. Jim Banks of Indiana who said before the midterms he would enthusiastically back him for president in 2028. “If JD runs, he has my full support,” Banks said in an interview this week. “He continues to lead in all the polls on the Republican side to be the nominee. He's my friend. We come from the same part of the country, the same background, and he's what the country needs. I hope he runs. But I don't know if he's running or not.” Rep. Brandon Gill (R-Texas) called Vance “a friend who I’ve had the honor to work alongside. He’s the vice president, of course he’s a front-runner.” Rep. Riley Moore (R-W.Va.) said in an interview that it was the Republican “party” and not its “policies” that suffered massive losses last week. But he doesn’t blame Vance, and he supports him for the 2028 presidential race. Vance, for his part, made his own allusion to the situation he’s found himself in. "I wanted to talk, of course, about the devastating loss last week. …There are a lot of people, I think, unfairly criticizing the leader of the team … a lot of staff infighting. … And of course, there's a conversation about whether the No. 2 has what it takes to ultimately lead the team.” He finished: “I'm talking, of course, about the Ohio State Buckeyes."
articles.headline: ‘Draft Marco’ effort grows on Capitol Hill after midterms bloodbath

articles.body: Former President Joe Biden would not have run for reelection in 2024 if he had known about his cancer, he said in an interview released Wednesday in which he also sought to downplay the historic debate performance that helped end his political career. "If I had known that I was feeling lousy because I had cancer, I would have not gone forward because I don't think an 80-year-old man with cancer should be running," he said in the interview with People magazine , which was conducted last week following Democrats’ big midterm wins and ahead of his upcoming memoir’s release. The former president announced his diagnosis — Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer — in May 2025, just four months after leaving the White House. It triggered an outpouring of public support — but it also raised questions about how doctors failed to catch the cancer earlier and whether it might have contributed to Biden’s apparent decline toward the end of his term. “I think it’s very sad, actually. I’m surprised that it wasn’t, you know, the public wasn’t notified a long time ago because to get to [a Gleason score of] 9, that’s a long time,” President Donald Trump told reporters shortly after Biden’s announcement. Prior to his diagnosis, Biden hadn’t been screened for prostate cancer since 2014 . U.S. guidelines have long recommended that men shouldn't be screened for the cancer once they hit their 70s. Biden also downplayed his poor June 2024 debate performance against Trump that contributed to his exit from the Democratic ticket a month later. “To me, it was not very consequential,” he said. “First of all, I thought there would be another debate, which there wasn’t. But notwithstanding the fact that there wasn’t another debate, it didn’t disturb me because it wasn’t consequential.” Biden’s son, Hunter, has said he believes the cancer was responsible for the performance. His weak showing on the debate stage led to mounting calls within his party for him to withdraw, an effort eventually backed by longtime friends and allies such as former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi . The former president’s memoir , “Promise Me, America,” will go on sale next week. Biden wrote Sunday on X that the cancer meant he “won’t be able to do as many conversations about my book as I’d hoped.” But he still feels sharp, he told the magazine. “I’m not saying I’ll live forever, but the point is that, you know, I have all my faculties, I have access to all the things I had before and, you know, I feel good,” he said.
articles.headline: Biden says he wouldn't have run in 2024 if he knew about his cancer

articles.body: When Annie Andrews announced her longshot campaign for U.S. Senate last May, the Democrat from South Carolina pitched herself as a “busy mom.” “Lindsey [Graham] is going to tell you I am radical, that I am crazy,” Andrews said in her launch video . “But here’s the thing: I am literally a busy mom and a pediatrician who plays peek-a-boo with my patients, watches Bluey with my kids … and spends most of my free time shuttling them to dance, Tae Kwon Do and football.” Now, she is one of a record number of women who will serve in the next Congress. And as a 46-year-old mother of three school-aged children, she’s among several Democratic women who flipped seats and governor’s mansions this November with campaign messages centered on parenting and affordability. It’s a notable campaign shift from previous election cycles: This year, female candidates focused less on the historic nature of their bids, or culture war issues that have long fomented divisions over gender and electability. Instead, they zeroed in on an economic message emphasizing bread-and-butter concerns — like how rising costs were squeezing families, including theirs. “Moms understand kitchen table issues better than perhaps anyone,” said Jessica Mackler, president of EMILY’s List, the group that recruits and backs female Democratic candidates who support abortion rights. “They understand how to stretch a paycheck. They understand what it is like to walk through a grocery store and have to put something back on the shelf.” Senate, House and gubernatorial campaigns spent a combined $72 million on ads featuring the words “mom” or “mother” in 2026, according to AdImpact — a 50% increase from the $48 million spent in 2024 and double the spending on these kind of ads from 2022. In many races, Democrats leaned on their experiences as parents to dismiss the kind of culture war attacks that have been effective for Republicans in recent years. “They want to run an entire campaign saying that I’m too woke … I plan to spend an entire campaign focused on the fact that working people are too broke,” Democratic Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa said in one of her final TV ads . “My pronouns are mom, Texan and soon-to-be governor.” Campaign messaging around gender and representation can be fraught: In 2016, Hillary Clinton’s “I’m With Her” campaign slogan fell short as she failed in her pledge to break the “highest, hardest glass ceiling.” In 2024, Kamala Harris’ campaign was decidedly less overt in its messaging about the barrier-breaking potential of her candidacy. But debates about gender seemed inescapable as Trump called her “weak” and then-Sen. JD Vance said the Democratic Party was run by “childless cat ladies.” This cycle was different. In a 2026 environment driven by concerns about affordability and the cost of living, Democratic operatives said it was an easy decision for women and mothers in particular to lean on their home lives to connect with voters. At least 159 women will serve in the 120th Congress, according to the Center for American Women and Politics, with Democratic women outnumbering Republicans by roughly five-to-one. Many of the newly elected Democrats are younger moms. Their victories, especially in battleground districts and states long seen as Republican strongholds, have emboldened Democratic groups dedicated to electing more women, who argue the candidates offer a blueprint for winning races going forward. Veteran Democratic pollster Celinda Lake said her party’s female candidates “really got points for having the right priorities and being in touch with real people's lives." "It used to be that women with young children just didn't run, and we were electing all these women who had grown children or no children, and then we were electing women with young children, but they were hiding them, if you will,” Lake said. “Now [candidates] were bringing them out as major credentialers, and that has been changing over time." Winning Democratic candidates told POLITICO they did not hesitate to talk about their families and personal experiences on the trail. “I didn’t need anyone giving me talking points on how expensive groceries are,” said Representative-elect Teresa Benitez-Thompson, who won a heavily Republican House district in northern Nevada. “I don’t need anyone telling me how expensive gas is because I am filling up my tank … running kids all around town.” JoAnna Mendoza, a single mom who flipped a swing district in the Tucson, Arizona, suburbs – said she spent the night before the election in the emergency room with her 10-year-old son. “That is what parents face. That is what moms go through. Their kids are sick, they have to take time off of work, or they have to leave work,” Mendoza said. “It is important for people to see themselves in their elected leaders.” Uncomfortable questions surrounding gender and electability nevertheless persist in the run-up to the next presidential election. Some in the Democratic Party at least privately question whether they should nominate another woman at the top of the ticket in 2028. “My message to people who would say that is: cut it out,” said Mackler. “This election clearly demonstrates that women are the drivers of Democrats' path to power, and we should embrace their leadership at all levels of the ballot.” Lake, the Democratic pollster, said the surge in female Democratic victors showed how fed up voters are with the status quo, calling it a “Hail Mary for change.” “It is so bad, it is so failed, we're going to elect these women who will hold people accountable,” she said, adding that voters, particularly women, “were really upset with how out of touch the older white men seemed with their families' lives” after a decade of Trump and Joe Biden running the country. Democratic candidates do not have a monopoly on talking about family life. Sarah Huckabee Sanders, the Republican governor of Arkansas, sailed to reelection last week with a campaign that highlighted her three children and efforts to cut grocery taxes and bring down the cost of living for other families. Messages around motherhood also featured prominently at the Republican National Committee’s midterm convention in Dallas, Texas, earlier this year. The messaging is part of a broader shift in the public conversation, said Abby McCloskey, a conservative policy analyst. “For a long time, to be taken seriously in politics, your professional side went first and your personal side went far after, and that was especially the case for women,” she said. “I think there's been broader cultural shifts that, and probably in a desire for authenticity and connection, why that is no longer necessarily the case.”Democratic campaign veterans said the renewed focus on motherhood gave their candidates an edge as they try to counter swing voters’ deep-seated biases against female candidates. One Democratic pollster, granted anonymity to speak candidly about voters’ biases, said voters still have “bad reactions” to women running for office who are perceived as “cold.” Talking about motherhood and family life, the pollster said, allowed candidates to come across as warm while pushing back against the idea that their candidates are too radical or left-wing. “In some of these places where you have to win over a bunch of conservative folks, the candidate can come across as just a regular mom,” the pollster said. “Not a scary, left, woke lady.” The beginning of Jocelyn Benson’s campaign launch video showed the Democrat hugging her son in their family’s kitchen. Now Michigan’s Democratic governor-elect, Benson told POLITICO she was “very intentional” about inviting kids to join her on stage during her celebration on Election Night. “I think leaders in this moment, and I think parents, moms in particular, recognize this as an opportunity to show a different way of leading and of being a good person and a good citizen,” she said.

articles.body: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore said Democrats should work toward bipartisan deals, including on immigration, with Stephen Miller — despite the “well of distrust” he holds for the new White House chief of staff. Moore, a potential 2028 Democratic presidential candidate, told POLITICO’s Alex Burns on Tuesday that even though Miller is “the architect of some of the most racist, xenophobic, homophobic policies that we have,” he still believes there’s room to negotiate with the White House to ease the targeting of unauthorized immigrants living in the U.S. “One thing I've always said to the people of my state is I will work with anybody, I will bow to nobody,” he said at the U.S. Chamber of Commerce’s B20 Summit. “I wish that there was a different team, because I think the well of distrust that Stephen Miller and his policies have fostered have been deeply poisonous,” the governor continued. “But I still want to make sure that we're doing good things on behalf of the people of our jurisdictions, and I do think we have a window to do it.” President Donald Trump floated the possibility of a bipartisan immigration deal during a “60 Minutes” interview on Sunday as he acknowledged that the aggressive deportation policies he enacted at the beginning of his term were “too tough” and “took people that had good jobs.” Trump appeared to reverse course on Monday , telling reporters he opposed offering “amnesty” for undocumented immigrants. Voters have long said Trump’s mass deportation campaign is too aggressive, and some Hill Republicans have pointed the blame at Miller, who masterminded the policy, for their lost support among Hispanics this midterm cycle. Moore said there’s a window for “real bipartisan agreement” on immigration despite Miller’s ascension last week. Oklahoma GOP Gov. Kevin Stitt, who co-chairs the National Governors Association with Moore and also spoke at the summit, said Trump “won on a strong border” — but governors need a “seat at the table” when it comes to issuing workforce permits. Asked what message it sends to international business to have a top staffer in the White House who is a hardliner on immigration, Stitt deflected. “I'm not going to speak to his hardlineness on that issue,” Stitt said, referring to Miller. He added that he thinks there’s a path forward for unauthorized immigrants contributing to the economy: “If you are here chasing the American dream, contributing to society, and you've come here illegally and a company is vouching for you, that's literally what we want. We educate people here, we want the best and brightest here, and I think there's a solution.” Stitt, who has not spoken to Trump since the midterms, said the president has "softened" on immigration in recent interviews. “There's a real solution, and I think President Trump can lead on it. He can lead and hopefully ... the Democrat majority in the House and the Senate will now work with him and we can get something done,” the Republican governor said. Moore, in the interview, also pointed to AI safety as an area for potential bipartisan agreement and urged the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress to create federal regulations on AI companies that include “protections on our pocketbooks” along with protections for workforce development and infrastructure. So far, much of the regulation has been left to the states. But Democrats in Congress are weighing multiple bills to enact safety standards protecting consumers from AI as Americans grow increasingly concerned about the dangers of the technology. “It’s not useful to have 50 different guidelines for how this country should think about this,” Moore said. “We need Washington to get in the game.” The Democrat also warned businesses to stay away from Trump’s ballroom and meme coin. "I would tell you right now that this will not age well,” Moore told the audience at the B20 summit. “There will not be a long term benefit to this. That with the American people, the best way for us to fight for capitalism is to make sure that we're building a system that everyone can see the benefit for and that we're not parsing off who it can actually benefit." Andrew Howard contributed to this report.
articles.headline: Wes Moore wants immigration reform. Can he work with Stephen Miller?

articles.body: The 2028 presidential race is already playing out in the text threads and phone calls of a new set of Democratic power brokers. A number of would-be White House contenders — including former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg, Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, Maryland Gov. Wes Moore, former Ambassador Rahm Emanuel and Sens. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) and Cory Booker (D-N.J.) — have already reached out to various winners, interviews with rumored 2028 hopefuls and newly elected Democrats reveal. Incoming Reps. Nancy Lacore (D-S.C.) and Teresa Benitez-Thompson (D-Nev.), incoming Sens. Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, Chris Pappas in New Hampshire and Annie Andrews in South Carolina, and New Mexico Gov.-elect Deb Haaland all got calls. The outreach signals a desire among Democrats who surfed a massive blue wave to victory last week to leverage those wins and influence the coming presidential contest, both in key early primary states and battlegrounds. "Lots of congratulatory calls with 'we would like to have conversations soon,'" said Morgan Jackson, a senior adviser to Sen.-elect Roy Cooper in North Carolina. Some newly elected Democrats are openly positioning themselves as kingmakers on the road to 2028, arguing their campaigns offer templates for the next crop of White House aspirants. Others are positioning themselves as ambassadors to their states. El-Sayed wants his party's next presidential nominee to support passing progressive policies like Medicare for All — and told POLITICO he hopes they’ll agree with his unflinching criticism of U.S. military support for Israel. Incoming Michigan Rep. William Lawrence said that Democrats won a “clear mandate” to take on Big Tech, including data centers , and to prevent endless wars, and he wants those issues to stay on “top of the agenda for 2028.” Haaland told POLITICO ahead of Election Day she wants Democrats to "have a plan for Indian tribes." Their rise will influence the potential 2028 field’s ability to navigate new geography and new demands while courting established kingmakers and party leaders. And some warning signs are already emerging: Allies of Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa's are knives out for Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear , who they argue didn't do enough to help her as chair of the Democratic Governors Association and doesn't understand the power of Latino voters — a necessary component of any 2028 bid. First stop: South Carolina No state will be as central as South Carolina, which will go first on Democrats' presidential primary calendar and where the bench of candidates will be deepest. Longtime Democratic Rep. Jim Clyburn (S.C.) is still expected to reprise his role as the host and kingmaker . But Andrews’ and Lacore’s massive upsets last Tuesday have supercharged Democrats’ delegation in the state. Andrews has fielded multiple calls from potential presidential candidates since Election Day, according to a person with direct knowledge of her conversations. Lacore, too, has taken “many” congratulatory calls from potential Democratic candidates, per another person with direct knowledge. Sens. Raphael Warnock of Georgia and Kelly both campaigned for Andrews during the race, and Buttigieg and Beshear made appearances with Lacore in her coastal district. Clyburn has long been vocal about the direction of the Democratic Party, active on the trail and open with his endorsements and advice to presidential hopefuls — and just recently with POLITICO . It’s not clear how the two newcomers will seek to shape 2028: Representatives for both campaigns declined to comment. But Andrews, a pediatrician, made health care a central part of her campaign. And Lacore’s focus on veterans’ issues and national security could bring those to the forefront. The two of them and Clyburn are set to meet on Capitol Hill for the first time as South Carolina’s incoming delegation on Wednesday to plan how best to work together in Congress, according to a person familiar with the gathering. Antjuan Seawright, a Clyburn adviser and Democratic strategist, said the three Palmetto State Democrats will likely have “different” approaches to their involvement in the 2028 primary. “The three of them, individually and collectively, will have a tremendous opportunity to entertain and introduce South Carolina to the potential candidates who are seeking the office,” Seawright said. Kicking the tires in New Hampshire New Hampshire’s elected Democrats have long wielded outsize influence over the party’s nominating process in what was the first-in-the-nation primary state. Pappas, a four-term representative, and Rep.-elect Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of two longtime New Hampshire Democratic power players, are well steeped in 2028 after multiple potential candidates campaigned with them through the fall to gain footholds in the state. Pappas started signaling his status as a power broker in the final days of the election, and was on Kelly’s list of election-night phone calls. “We had a lot of visitors at the end of this campaign, maybe some folks who were just using me as an excuse to come visit New Hampshire and kick the tires a little bit,” Pappas said on WMUR in a post-election interview. Pappas told POLITICO on Monday he would “certainly” serve as an ambassador for candidates — and suggested there are “people who want to certainly come back soon. I think it’s going to kick off pretty quickly.” Jim Demers, a veteran Democratic strategist and liaison for presidential hopefuls in the state, told POLITICO he believes both Pappas and Shaheen could serve as key conduits for candidates looking to play in New Hampshire. “Both of them are very campaign smart, and so their advice to any of the potential presidential candidates will be important,” Demers said. “I would expect they’re going to be extremely popular and can be a big help to any of them who want help.” The progressive agenda in Michigan Michigan is already the epicenter of the Democratic Party’s most polarizing fights over policy and ideology. Now, the perennial battleground sits fifth in the presidential primary lineup. Few have been so openly positioning themselves to join the ranks of the state’s power brokers as El-Sayed, who declared even before his primary win that he would “dog” presidential hopefuls “up and down the state” to embrace his progressive platform, including Medicare for All. “It’s important to me that I've got a governing partner,” El-Sayed told POLITICO in a post-election interview. “I'm going to do what I can to make sure that I get one.” El-Sayed could play a significant role in shaping the debate over Israel in a state that gave rise to the “uncommitted” movement in 2024 — and where he ran aggressively against U.S. military aid to the country. The senator-elect said he hopes the next nominee will share his stance; when asked about that remark, Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro said he looks forward to “having a thoughtful conversation with” El-Sayed on the topic. “I will be advocating for what I believe to be right, and clearly my state agrees with me on this issue,” El-Sayed said, adding, “If you want to be where the voters are — if you want to be on the side of peace and on the side of justice and transparency — I believe that that is around holding Israel accountable to its war crimes and on making sure our tax dollars get used to do good things here rather than bad things somewhere else.” Others are ready to engage with their party’s future in a more neutral role. Jocelyn Benson, the moderate incoming governor, said in an interview that she will “certainly invite folks to come to our state to make their case to our residents.” Over in the West The West will have its biggest role in the calendar yet, with New Mexico joining Nevada as early calendar stops. As Nevada’s new top official with strong working-class appeal , Democratic Gov.-elect Aaron Ford could play a major role in shepherding 2028 candidates — should he choose to. He’s already fielded congratulatory calls from Moore, who leads the National Governors Association, and others. Benitez-Thompson, who will represent the large swath of rural northern Nevada, is already embracing her role as an ambassador for the region and has taken calls from a “number” of likely presidential contenders in the days after the midterm election. “I am dead set on making sure that I can bring resources home for northern Nevada and investments home into northern Nevada. I'll be talking to any and everyone who can help me move resources and levers to make that happen,” she said in an interview. "Come to northern Nevada, step off of the plane, but be ready for me to show you what our needs are." Adam Wren, Ali Bianco, Lauren Fedor, Aaron Pellish and Meredith Lee Hill contributed to this report.
articles.headline: A new set of Democratic power brokers just dropped before 2028

articles.body: A former business partner is accusing MAGA media guru Alex Bruesewitz of receiving lavish gifts from foreign individuals in Qatar and Syria while also pursuing lucrative deals with other entities looking to unlock access to U.S. government officials. The allegations were made in a court filing Monday by Derek Utley, who co-founded the digital firm X Strategies in 2017 with Bruesewitz. Bruesewitz is a top outside adviser to President Donald Trump , having helped shape his 2024 campaign’s digital strategy, and X Strategies maintains the Trump War Room and Team Trump accounts on X. The company sued Utley in September , alleging he embezzled and gambled away millions of dollars from the firm. In the Monday filing responding to that lawsuit, Utley calls it a “marketing ploy masquerading as a federal lawsuit” and denies allegations he embezzled the company’s money or used its funds to gamble. The filing includes a countersuit against X Strategies that claims Utley was fired from the company without cause over a requested medical leave. (The firm’s original lawsuit had claimed Utley submitted “fake medical records” to "fraudulently" get six months paid leave, and was then fired.) Utley doesn’t explicitly accuse Bruesewitz of offering foreign officials political access in exchange for payments, but charges that Bruesewitz “pursued substantial business and financial relationships with foreign individuals, investors, and governmental representatives, including persons associated with Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, and Syria” while concealing those relationships. The filing does not include documentation to support its allegations. “The relationships and access Bruesewitz cultivated through X Strategies were valuable commercial assets, particularly to foreign interests seeking introductions to American political figures, access to governmental institutions, or assistance advancing their commercial and political objectives,” the filing says. “Upon information and belief, Bruesewitz received approximately $500,000 from individuals associated with Qatar in connection with an undisclosed business or consulting arrangement.” Bruesewitz’s lawyer Bradford Cohen denied all the allegations. “These are things that would be defamatory if made outside the four corners of the complaint,” Cohen said Monday evening, vowing to "vigorously" defend against the allegations. “We're asserting that everything in his factual allegations is either untrue, exaggerated, or completely fabricated,” he said. “Desperate men resort to desperate things, and this screams of desperation.” Bruesewitz continues to advise conservative figures in Trump’s orbit. He also leveraged his relationships with foreign officials when the war with Iran broke out to help charter a flight back to the U.S. for himself and other Americans who were stranded in Qatar, according to his social media posts at the time. Utley did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Neither did the White House. In another example, Utley claims Bruesewitz sought to charge an annual advisory fee of $1 million to a “Copenhagen-based investment firm with holdings in the United States and Europe.” The proposed deal, the filing said, included services like “providing access to American governmental officials, federal agencies, and financial institutions.” “These circumstances raise questions concerning potential registration and disclosure obligations under FARA,” the court filing says, referencing the Foreign Agents Registration Act, which requires public disclosures from those involved in lobbying or other activities representing foreign interests. Additionally, the filing alleges that Bruesewitz told Utley that his honeymoon hotel stay in the Maldives was paid for by “two Syrian billionaires” who provided access to a suite that ordinarily costs $15,000 a night. Bruesewitz has previously advocated for conservative influencers to disclose their relationships with foreign governments seeking to sway the Trump administration. He also said during a June interview with Tucker Carlson that he does not take any foreign payments. “Getting foreign influence out of the political ecosystem, specifically online, is a very — it’s a passion project of mine,” Bruesewitz said in the interview. “You can only imagine the type of money that these countries and other companies have tried to throw at me. I do not take any foreign money. I don’t take any money from the Gulf countries. I don't take any money from India. I don't take any money from Russia, China. No foreign countries.”

articles.body: <p>Núcleo Nacional, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-06/varios-detenidos-en-una-operacion-de-la-policia-contra-el-grupo-nucleo-nacional.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-06/varios-detenidos-en-una-operacion-de-la-policia-contra-el-grupo-nucleo-nacional.html">el grupúsculo neonazi desmantelado la pasada semana tras 14 detenciones</a>, tenía una fijación: “los guarros”. Bajo este despectivo apelativo, los ultras englobaban a sus enemigos: musulmanes, judíos, inmigrantes, antifascistas y colectivos vulnerables, según los chats intervenidos por la Policía Nacional a los que ha tenido acceso EL PAÍS. Los mensajes forman parte de la investigación que desarrolla el Juzgado de Instrucción número 1 de Gijón y recogen las comunicaciones en las que los ultras planean acciones violentas contra mezquitas, sinagogas y centros de menores no acompañados. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-11/nucleo-nacional-planeo-atacar-mezquitas-y-sinagogas-hay-que-empezar-con-las-incineraciones.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Vivían puerta con puerta, pero no sabían su nombre. Cuando a primera hora del miércoles los furgones policiales cortaron la calle, los vecinos de la localidad de Montijo (15.195 habitantes, Badajoz) intuyeron que el operativo iba a la casa de fachada ocre y molduras destartaladas. Acertaron. Presintieron también que el registro tenía algo que ver con el tráfico de drogas. Que se equivocaban lo supieron cuando, como les ordenaron los agentes, regresaron a sus domicilios y la noticia de lo que ocurría en ese instante al otro lado de la calle les estalló en sus teléfonos. “Desarticulan una red criminal de tráfico y compraventa de bebés”. Una sinfonía de notificaciones, de titulares perturbadores que comenzaron a darle dimensiones pesadillescas a lo que pasaba en la casa de su vecina sin nombre. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-11/los-interrogantes-de-la-operacion-luna-que-se-sabe-y-que-no-sobre-la-presunta-venta-de-menores.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Hacía falta un gran templo para acoger a los familiares (cerca de 150) de las 69 víctimas del accidente ferroviario de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-08/nena-dime-algo-el-ultimo-mensaje-del-marido-de-una-victima-de-urda.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-08/nena-dime-algo-el-ultimo-mensaje-del-marido-de-una-victima-de-urda.html">Urda </a>(Toledo); a supervivientes heridos y a los profesionales de distintos uniformes que intervinieron en la emergencia; y, sin embargo, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-10/el-arzobispo-de-toledo-pide-en-el-funeral-de-las-victimas-del-tren-de-urda-que-se-asuman-responsabilidades-y-se-repare-en-justicia.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-10/el-arzobispo-de-toledo-pide-en-el-funeral-de-las-victimas-del-tren-de-urda-que-se-asuman-responsabilidades-y-se-repare-en-justicia.html">en la catedral de Toledo este martes no cabía tanto dolor.</a> El funeral sirvió para recordar, en medio de las polémicas y miserias de la precampaña electoral, que el tiempo se detuvo hace apenas 15 días para decenas de padres, hijos, hermanos, parejas y amigos de los pasajeros de los trenes siniestrados en la línea Madrid-Sevilla. También para poner de manifiesto la frivolidad de algunas manifestaciones recientes, como darse golpes en el pecho para celebrar en un mitin la dimisión de un compañero o hacer juegos de palabras con el nombre de un ministro. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-10/el-dolor-no-cabia-en-la-catedral-de-toledo.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El dolor no cabía en la catedral de Toledo

articles.body: <p>La Catedral de Toledo ha acogido este martes el funeral por los 69 fallecidos en el accidente de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-08/nena-dime-algo-el-ultimo-mensaje-del-marido-de-una-victima-de-urda.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-08/nena-dime-algo-el-ultimo-mensaje-del-marido-de-una-victima-de-urda.html">Urda</a> del pasado 28 de octubre, y el arzobispo, en una homilía cariñosa hacia las víctimas y contundente hacia las autoridades, ha lanzado un claro mensaje: que se esclarezcan las causas del accidente, que se depuren responsabilidades y que se repare en justicia.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-10/el-arzobispo-de-toledo-pide-en-el-funeral-de-las-victimas-del-tren-de-urda-que-se-asuman-responsabilidades-y-se-repare-en-justicia.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>El Gobierno ha decidido echar toda la carne en el asador en <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-19/el-gobierno-arranca-los-martes-sociales-con-un-decreto-para-mejorar-las-prestaciones-por-viudedad-incapacidad-para-victimas-del-terrorismo-y-de-violencia-de-genero.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-19/el-gobierno-arranca-los-martes-sociales-con-un-decreto-para-mejorar-las-prestaciones-por-viudedad-incapacidad-para-victimas-del-terrorismo-y-de-violencia-de-genero.html">políticas sociales y mensajes progresistas</a> en estas últimas tres semanas antes de las elecciones. El Ejecutivo hará dos consejos de ministros extraordinarios, este viernes y el próximo, además de los dos ordinarios que quedan los dos martes, según fuentes del Gobierno, porque las medidas que tiene que aprobar son tantas y tan diferentes que necesita dividirlas en cuatro. Además, así se garantiza ocupar más espacio mediático y generar más debate con sus iniciativas, que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-05/un-precedente-con-muchas-y-radicales-dudas-es-constitucional-aprobar-los-decretos-de-vivienda-tras-la-disolucion-de-las-cortes.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-05/un-precedente-con-muchas-y-radicales-dudas-es-constitucional-aprobar-los-decretos-de-vivienda-tras-la-disolucion-de-las-cortes.html">tendrán que ser aprobadas en la Diputación Permanente.</a> El Ejecutivo solo ha dejado libre el último viernes antes de las elecciones, día del cierre de campaña. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-10/el-gobierno-multiplica-las-medidas-sociales-antes-de-las-elecciones-y-apoya-la-huelga-general.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: Malgrat que moltes de les dutxes actuals són de mampara, encara es mantenen les típiques dutxes de cortina, les de tota la vida. Qui estigui familiaritzat amb aquest tipus de dutxa s’haurà fixat en un fenomen que succeeix gairebé sempre i que acostuma a ser força empipador: el de com s’arrapa la cortina al cos quan ens dutxem amb aigua calenta. No es tracta d’un fet particular, que només ens passa a nosaltres. L’explicació rau en un fenomen físic que reprodueix, a molt petita escala, el comportament de les masses d’aire a escala atmosfèrica. També et pot interessar Així es formen els núvols, els ruixats i les tempestes de tarda Manel Cascante Torrella 5 minuts de lectura L’aigua calenta, la responsable de fer variar la pressió atmosfèrica Quan ens dutxem, l’aigua calenta escalfa l’aire de l’interior de la dutxa amb celeritat. L’aire calent, menys dens, tendeix a elevar-se i sortir per la part superior de la dutxa. D’aquesta manera es produeix una mena de buit de pressió a l’interior de la cortina . La pressió més baixa dins de la dutxa és compensada per la pressió de l’aire més alta que hi ha a l’exterior. Com que l’aire es mou de més a menys pressió, l’aire de l’exterior de la dutxa empeny la cortina cap a nosaltres per tal d’equilibrar la pressió. És en aquest moment quan notem que la cortina se’ns arrapa. Per tallar aquesta dinàmica, la solució és passar de l’aigua calenta a l’aigua freda. Un remei ràpid tot i que sovint suposi haver de passar fred. Aquest fenomen reprodueix a petita escala el comportament de les masses d’aire a l’atmosfera . Els centres de baixes pressions es caracteritzen, en general, per moviments ascendents de l’aire al seu interior, els anticiclons, per contra, per moviments descendents (subsidència). Convé recordar també que quan el sol escalfa la superfície del terra, l’aire que contacta amb aquest també s’escalfa i tendeix a ascendir si les condicions són favorables. Aquest aire calent en ascendir es refreda. El vapor d’aigua contingut en aquesta massa d’aire pot acabar condensant-se i formar núvols. Els rellotges intel·ligents també detecten el canvi de pressió atmosfèrica a la dutxa Molts rellotges intel·ligents incorporen actualment un petit baròmetre i un altímetre. El baròmetre és l’aparell que detecta les variacions de pressió atmosfèrica (el “pes de l’aire”). Quan guanyem altura, per exemple si pugem una muntanya, la pressió atmosfèrica tendirà a disminuir. Mentre que en condicions normals la pressió atmosfèrica a nivell del mar és de 1.013 hPa, a 1.500 m és de 850 hPa i a 3.000 m és de 700 hPa. El baròmetre també pot variar alguns hectopascals sense haver de pujar en altura. Podem arribar a observar variacions de pressió sense moure’ns de casa, en funció de si ens afecta un centre d’altes o de baixes pressions. Si la pressió disminueix gradualment al llarg del dia, ens indicarà l’aproximació d’un centre de baixes pressions, d’una borrasca. Si tendeix a augmentar, ens indicarà l’aproximació d’un centre d’altres pressions, d’un anticicló. Aquells qui es dutxin amb el rellotge al canell podran comprovar que si ho fan amb aigua calenta la pressió atmosfèrica variarà diversos hectopascals al llarg de la dutxa, en aquest cas disminuirà. L’explicació d’aquesta variació serà la mateixa que explica que la cortina de la dutxa se’ns arrapi al cos, es a dir, l’elevació de l’aire calent a l’interior de la dutxa i la creació d’un petit buit de pressió, un minúscul centre de baixes pressions local.  Les ampolles de plàstic mig buides o les bosses de patates també evidencien els efectes de la pressió atmosfèrica Aquells qui facin muntanya hauran observat probablement també els efectes de la variació de la pressió atmosfèrica en ampolles de plàstic i en bosses de patates o de fruita seca. Quan pugem una muntanya i traiem de la motxilla l’ampolla d’aigua de plàstic o la bossa de patates observem que s’han inflat i deformat. L’explicació rau en què l’aire atrapat a l’interior de la bombolla de plàstic o de la bossa de patates es trobava a una pressió atmosfèrica superior a la qual té l’aire dalt de la muntanya en què ens trobem. Com que la pressió sempre va de més a menys , l’envàs es deforma. articles.body: 400.000 persones, segons l’organització , han sortit al carrer per plantar-se davant la crisi de l’habitatge. La Guàrdia Urbana , però, ha rebaixat la xifra d’assistents, amb dades de les 18.45 h, a les 55.000 persones . La manifestació multitudinària de la tarda ha representat el moment culminant d’una jornada de vaga general d’ èxit, segons els sindicats i de seguiment baix, segons la patronal. La marxa ha acabat a la plaça de Catalunya poc abans de les 19 h quan la capçalera ha arribat al final del recorregut i ha donat la manifestació per desconvocada. La mobilització, convocada per les plataformes Ens Costa la Vida , el Sindicat de Llogateres i la Taula Sindical de Catalunya tenia uns reclams clars: uns salaris dignes que permetin accedir un habitatge assequible , una baixada dels lloguers , defensar els serveis públics i, en última instància i de retruc, denunciar l’elevat cost de la vida amb què viu la ciutadania. El Sindicat d’Habitatge Socialista de Catalunya (SHSC) i el sindicat Solidaritat Obrera (SO) han fet una crida a sumar-se a una mobilització alternativa que ha sortit a les 17 h de la plaça de Mossèn Jacint Verdaguer . Entre els motius de diferenciar-se, l’entitat diu que es nega a cedir la capçalera als líders de CCOO i UGT, a qui consideren “sucursals del Govern espanyol” i que, a més, no han convocat cap altra vaga general en 14 anys . articles.body: El boix grèvol ( Ilex aquifolium ) és un arbre de mida modesta —normalment de port arbustiu—, fruits vermells i fulles perennes i punxegudes que, tradicionalment s’ha usat per a guarniments i decoracions de Nadal. El boix grèvol es considera un símbol de Nadal , un fet que va propiciar que en el passat se n’abusés i que calgués protegir-lo. Ara fa unes dècades, a tall d’exemple, en alguns pobles dels Pirineus era habitual tallar un grèvol i posar-lo dins de casa com a arbre de Nadal. La molsa també és un element vegetal que acostumava a usar-se en pessebres i per decorar. Es tracta d’una espècie sensible i d’alt valor ecològic, motiu pel qual també convé evitar collir-ne. També et pot interessar Mercats de Nadal a Barcelona 2026: quins hi ha i què hi trobaràs per regalar Neus Valls Núria Dias Sílvia Carbonell 5 minuts de lectura Canvi recent de normativa, però mantenint la prohibició de recol·lectar-ne L’any 1986 es va aprovar una ordre per la qual es regulava el verd nadalenc i es protegia legalment el boix grèvol pel seu gran valor ecològic. Des del maig del 2026 que el boix grèvol ha deixat de ser considerada una espècie protegida pel fet de trobar-nos en un escenari molt diferent del dels anys 80. El motiu és l’abundància d’individus d’aquesta espècie, el seu estat de conservació favorable i la seva inclusió dins de la categoria d’espècies de “preocupació menor” a la llista vermella de la Unió Internacional per a la Conservació de la Natura (UICN). Malgrat aquest canvi normatiu, es manté la prohibició d’arrencar cap exemplar, així com la recol·lecció de branques de boix grèvol amb finalitats ornamentals per tal de garantir la persistència de l’espècie. Només es pot comercialitzar el boix grèvol que provingui de conreu o viver autoritzat , en cap cas del medi natural. Gaudim d’un #Nadal respectuós amb el medi natural. El boix grèvol NO es pot agafar al bosc. És una planta protegida. Els fruits són aliment per a molts animals, i tòxics per als humans. Compra’n en llocs especialitzats o opta per alternatives sostenibles. pic.twitter.com/2Mj1fKpweU — Agents Rurals (@agentsruralscat) December 14, 2025 El grèvol, base d’alimentació i refugi d’algunes espècies El boix grèvol és una planta dioica, això vol dir que hi ha exemplars masculins i femenins per separat, una dada important que convé tenir present si pretenem plantar-ne un al jardí ja que només els femenins produiran fruits. Les fulles de la part baixa dels grèvols solen tenir punxes ben marcades per tal d’evitar que els animals se les mengin. Les de la part superior, per contra, acostumen a tenir els marges llisos. S’ha vist que si un herbívor mossega les fulles baixes, la planta respon fent que les noves fulles creixin amb punxes. El fruit del boix grèvol és la base d’alimentació de moltes espècies de fauna salvatge i sovint n’és l’única font. En zones com el Montseny, per exemple, a l’entorn de Santa Fe, a l’hivern sol servir de refugi de les baixes temperatures a diversos animals , sobretot ocells, així com d’aliment. Les fulles espesses creen un petit microclima al seu interior i fan que la temperatura sigui uns graus més alta que la del seu entorn. Igualment convé evitar collir espècies alternatives que es caracteritzin pels fruits vermells , tot i que no tinguin una normativa estricta que en prohibeixi la recol·lecció . No hem de collir, així doncs, plantes com el galzeran, la rosa silvestre o l’arç blanc , entre d’altres, ja que la sobrepressió també pot tenir greus conseqüències per a la fauna i l’ecosistema. Convé recordar que els fruits de totes aquestes plantes i arbres són la dieta bàsica hivernal de molts animals , entre els quals els ocells. #Sabiesque el boix grèvol, la molsa o l'avet són espècies que tenen una funció important en l'ecosistema? Ariadna Corominas del Hoyo Lluís Cruz Berasategui Marcos Amores Sánchez 2 minuts de lectura La tradició de guarnir amb grèvol El grèvol ha estat tradicionalment relacionat amb Nadal i les festes associades durant segles. Igual que les cançons de Nadal i els arbres, els seus orígens es remunten al nord d’Europa. El boix grèvol era una planta de gran importància per als pagans. Per als celtes , el boix grèvol atreia la bona sort i la prosperitat, i per això el feien servir quan arribava el solstici d’hivern. Per als druides , era una planta sagrada, i també ho era per als antics romans , que l’associaven amb el déu Saturn. A més, per als romans, un altre tret distintiu del boix grèvol era que les seves fulles perennes remetien a la vida eterna. El grèvol, el vesc i el galzeran són tres de les plantes silvestres més emprades durant les festes de Nadal per ornamentar el pessebre o la llar. També et pot interessar Com cuidar l’arbre de Nadal perquè sobrevisqui després de les festes? Manel Cascante Torrella 3 minuts de lectura La molsa, en alguns llocs, també està protegida La molsa és una petita planta de color verd viu que acostuma a encatifar el sòl de zones ombrívoles o humides. Té una gran capacitat de retenció d’aigua, protegeix el sòl de l’erosió, actua d’hàbitat d’animals petits i actua de substrat per a la germinació de llavors d’altres plantes. A causa de la seva funció ecològica no s’aconsella la seva recol·lecció. En general no és una espècie protegida a Catalunya, però en alguns llocs concrets sí que ho és de forma específica, sobretot en espais naturals protegits : parcs naturals, parcs nacionals i en espais inclosos al Pla d’Espais d’Interès Natural (PEIN). A banda, també és prohibeix en zones amb espècies de molses protegides, en fonts i al costat dels rierols, o bé en boscos cremats recentment. En qualsevol cas convé usar alternatives com utilitzar molsa artificial o bé d’altres materials que puguin fer una funció similar. Si se’n compra, aquesta ha de procedir de cultiu controlat. La molsa té una funció molt important al #bosc i és l'habitat d'animals petits. Té una gran capacitat de retenció d'aigua, acumula nutrients, fa de substrat per a la germinació de llavors i protegeix el sòl. articles.body: La jornada de vaga general d’aquest dimecres ha tingut un alt seguiment segons els sindicats, però una adhesió baixa segons la patronal. Les dades, com acostuma a passar, no coincideixen. Mentre que CCOO i UGT parlen d’un 84 % de seguiment a Catalunya, la Pimec rebaixa la xifra a un 8,3 %. També et pot interessar Vaga general 11-N: 50 detinguts pels aldarulls al centre un cop acabada la manifestació Ester Magdaleno Javier Arilla Jessica Moreno Cusac Marta Casals Torres Sílvia Carbonell 1 minut de lectura La vaga a Catalunya, la de més seguiment de l’estat Per CCOO la vaga ha paralitzat aquest dimecres al matí “tots els sectors de la producció, el comerç, la indústria, el transport i l’educació”. La secretària general del sindicat a Catalunya, Belén López, ha reclamat que la patronal s’assegui a negociar increments salarials i que els polítics garanteixin el dret a l’habitatge. Camil Ros, secretari general d’UGT, s’ha felicitat que les carreteres hagin estat buides i ha dit que la vaga a Catalunya és la de més seguiment de tot l’estat. També et pot interessar Manifestació per la vaga general de l’11 de novembre: horari, lloc i manifest Clara Aliaguilla 2 minuts de lectura Seguiment baix i desigual al territori, segons la patronal La patronal Foment del Treball no ha donat una xifra concreta però parla de seguiment baix. Yésika Aguilar, directora de Laboral de Foment, ha dit que l’entitat respecta el dret a vaga però ha lamentat que no s’hagi respectat el dret dels treballadors que, segons diu, volien anar al seu lloc de treball i no han pogut per l’acció dels piquets. També ho atribueix a la falta de transport públic i a uns serveis mínims , diu, insuficients. De la seva banda, Pimec sí que hi posa xifres. Josep Ginesta, secretari general de l’organització, ha dit que amb dades fins al migdia, un 8,3 % de treballadors havien secundat l’aturada . Malgrat que el seguiment és inferior a la d’altres convocatòries, Ginesta diu que “ menys persones han produït un efecte superior ” perquè l’afectació a les empreses ha estat rellevant; un 27,5 % d’empreses han vist la seva activitat afectada, segons Pimec. Això fa que a molts dels barris la imatge s’hagi assemblat a la d’un diumenge o dia festiu. Sí que lamenten alguns actes vandàlics, amb pintades a les persianes, en algunes botigues d’eixos de barri. Per Comertia, l’associació d’empreses catalanes del sector del detall, el seguiment ha estat desigual i s’ha concentrat a les vies més cèntriques.

articles.body: Moltes són les persones que s’han vist sorpreses aquest dimecres de vaga general per la falta de transport públic per moure’s arreu del territori i, molt especialment, per l’àrea metropolitana de Barcelona. La ciutadania i els usuaris de busos i trens fa temps que s’adapten a la incidències, manca d’oferta i a les vagues que es van convocant, però uns serveis mínims del 25 % de 6.30 a 9.30 h i de 16.30 a 21 h , que passen a ser del 0 % la resta del dia han agafat desprevinguda bona part de la ciutadania. També et pot interessar Vaga general 11-N: 50 detinguts pels aldarulls al centre un cop acabada la manifestació Ester Magdaleno Javier Arilla Jessica Moreno Cusac Marta Casals Torres Sílvia Carbonell 1 minut de lectura Això vol dir que entre les 9.30 hores i les 16.30, no circulen ni metros, ni trens, ni tramvies, ni busos urbans ni interurbans . I la situació es repeteix a partir de les 21 hores. I quin és el motiu? Per què Catalunya té els serveis mínims més restrictius d’Espanya ? A la resta de l’estat Rodalies funciona al 75 % en hores punta i al 50 % en hores vall. I en ciutats com Madrid o València es garanteix el pas del metro al 80 % del servei a les hores de més afluència i la dada baixa —però segueix funcionant—, a les hores vall. A la resta de l’estat, busos urbans i interurbans també circulen amb percentatges variables en funció de la comunitat, però circulen. La particularitat de Catalunya es diu “acords en fred”. Què són els acords en fred del 2006? Els serveis mínims a Catalunya els estableix el Departament d’Empresa i Treball i, quan es pregunta pels motius d’aquests serveis mínims tan baixos al transport, la resposta ha estat la següent: “Pels acords en fred del 2006” , que es diuen així —expliquen les mateixes fonts— perquè se signen en moments que no hi ha conflicte ni vagues a la vista. Això, perquè s’entén que en aquests períodes de pau és més fàcil arribar a un pacte sobre els serveis mínims que es pot aplicar en futures aturades.. Explica el govern, que els acords de serveis mínims en fred es van consensuar durant els anys 2005 i 2006 —amb el govern del tripartit— entre associacions sindicals i empresarials de sectors com la sanitat, el transport de mercaderies i empreses de transport de viatgers. Ara, 20 anys més tard, s’han aplicat al sector del transport i el sanitari. Mirant enrere, també es van aplicar al transport durant la vaga general del 2010 , i dos anys més tard, en la vaga general del 2012 , també, tot i que aleshores el percentatge de prestació de servei en hores punta va pujar del 25 al 33 % . També et pot interessar Serveis mínims per la vaga general de l’11 de novembre al transport públic, educació i sanitat Emma Monrós Rosell 2 minuts de lectura Fonts sindicals celebren que els serveis mínims es basen en aquests acords en fred i consideren que en la resta de sectors en què no s’han aplicat, els serveis mínims són massa alts . Això, mentre les patronals fa dies que posen el crit al cel. Creuen que uns serveis mínims tan baixos al transport són abusius i denuncien que dificulten el dret a anar a treballar . Reiteren, també, que la vaga “no resoldrà el problema de l’habitatge” i ho vinculen amb el clima electoral .

Sentir-se malament quan un dia no es pot anar a entrenar, retallar hores de son per llevar-se d’hora i no saltar-se una sessió… Us sona? Són símptomes d’autoexigència, una manera de ser que pot provocar culpa i frustració si no s’aconsegueix l’objectiu marcat. Parlem de la pressió de rendir en aquest episodi de Fase Estàtica amb Andrea Arroyo, psicòloga sanitària i dietista-nutricionista, i amb la Mireia Guarner Piquet, metgessa de família i fisiòloga, que compagina la seva professió amb la competició de carrera de fons d’alt nivell. articles.body: Albades i postes de sol enceses són un espectacle, també a Barcelona. Tot i que se’n veuen al llarg de tot l’any, és justament ara, quan el sol va tan baix, que es fan més freqüents i sovint més espectaculars. El pas de fronts atlàntics desgastats aporten molts núvols alts i mitgencs que acaben tenyint-se de colors vius a l’alba o a la posta del sol. albada del 6 de gener del 2026. Foto: Alfons Puertas El perquè dels colors rogencs Per explicar  el perquè de les tonalitats rogenques  a la  sortida o posta del sol  cal recordar que la  llum blanca està formada per diferents colors , cadascun amb una longitud d’ona diferent. Quan els rajos solars arriben a l’atmosfera, interactuen amb les diferents partícules o molècules que hi ha en suspensió i es produeix aleshores el fenomen de la  dispersió . Els  colors blaus es dispersen més que els altres colors , bàsicament perquè tenen més energia. És per aquest motiu que el  cel és blau a les hores centrals del dia. Al  vespre, i també a la sortida del sol , els rajos solars arriben a la superfície terrestre  molt més inclinats  que no pas al centre de la jornada. Han de creuar molta més distància d’aire a l’atmosfera, i això implica que hi hagi moltes més molècules pel mig i  es vagin dispersant progressivament i perdent els diferents colors : primer els  blaus , després els  verds , els  grocs  i,  finalment, els vermells . És en aquest moment en què el cel pot mostrar les coloracions més rogenques. La presència de  núvols alts o mitjans permet que el cel pugui adquirir tons especialment rogencs  pel fet que els rajos acaben  tenyint de manera gradual la part baixa d’aquests núvols . També et pot interessar Altocúmuls lenticulars, els núvols de vent que sovint desfilen pel cel de Barcelona | VÍDEO Manel Cascante Torrella 4 minuts de lectura Podem preveure si un dia en concret es produirà una posta o sortida de sol encesa? Posta de sol del 25 de gener del 2025. Foto: Alfons Puertas (Observatori Fabra-RACAB) La presència de capes de núvols alts i mitgencs al cel són un dels ingredients bàsics perquè es produeixin celatges acolorits. Ara bé, si el cel és totalment cobert per aquest tipus de núvols (sense cap escletxa) difícilment obtindrem el resultat esperat. Perquè es pugui veure acolorida la  sortida , cal que el cel estigui clar a llevant (hi hagi clarianes) —per on sortirà el sol— però que hi hagi núvols prims cap a l’oest. A la  posta , per contra, convé que hi hagi clarianes o cel clar a l’oest —per on es pondrà el sol— i núvols cap a llevant. Tarda de cel enterbolit. Possible posta de sol rogenca, estigueu atents Ara, 15 ºC i 50% HR. https://t.co/IzcvvSItCK pic.twitter.com/PIp7WwhDo0 — btv el temps (@btveltemps) December 26, 2021 Cel rogent, pluja o vent Aquest refrany tan conegut es basa en el fet que a la nostra latitud i posició, a l’est de la península Ibèrica, les borrasques i fronts procedents de l’Atlàntic arriben normalment amb poca empenta i s’anuncien prèviament amb l’arribada de núvols alts i mitjans des de l’oest. Si al vespre, coincidint amb la posta del sol, ja els veiem arribar per ponent, possiblement al cap d’unes hores (l’endemà) arribarà el gruix del front que descarregarà alguns xàfecs o plugims. La posta de sol encesa, en aquest cas, haurà anunciat pluja. Si, per contra el front arriba desgastat, un fet habitual sobretot a la costa catalana, els seus efectes es notaran bàsicament en un gir o entrada sobtada de vent, normalment de ponent, mestral o tramuntana, i no tant en l’arribada de precipitacions. El cel rogent ens haurà anunciat el vent . També et pot interessar El “jet stream”: 400 km/h de vent en una cinta transportadora Roger Solé Guinart 4 minuts de lectura

articles.body: El fred d’hivern és cada cop més difícil de veure i la suavitat es va instal·lant també en mesos tradicionalment freds, com el desembre . Tot i que encara és poc habitual, cada cop és més recurrent assolir els 20 ºC al desembre a l’Observatori Fabra – RACAB . També et pot interessar Els mesos més càlids són gairebé tots del segle XXI: quin lloc ocupa cada mes al rànquing? Marcos Amores Sánchez 3 minuts de lectura Només set cops s’han superat els 20 ºC Tant és així que només hi ha set registres al desembre, en els 113 anys de dades que té l’Observatori Fabra – RACAB en què la temperatura ha aconseguit superar els 20 ºC , un valor que correspon més al que seria habitual a principis del mes de maig. Aquests set registres de més de 20 ºC al desembre s’han donat tots al segle XXI i concentrats en els darrers 10 anys, amb un desembre del 2022 en què aquesta marca es va superar en fins a quatre ocasions, amb rècord absolut inclòs el 31 de desembre amb 22,4 ºC. D’aquell desembre (del 2022) ens queda també el rècord de temperatura mitjana mensual i, de moment, l’any més càlid registrat en aquest punt de la ciutat. També et pot interessar El 2022 va ser l’any més càlid i sec a Catalunya com a mínim des del 1950 Manel Cascante Torrella 4 minuts de lectura Només dos precedents del segle XX arriben a 20 ºC Tot i que no s’han superat mai els 20 ºC a l’Observatori Fabra al desembre en el segle XX, el cert és que sí que s’hi ha arribat un parell de cops : el 1915 i el 1939. 31 de desembre del 2022 22,4 ºC 25 de desembre del 2022 22,1 ºC 24 de desembre del 2022 21,7 ºC 16 de desembre del 2015 20,6 ºC 30 de desembre del 2021 20,4 ºC 26 de desembre del 2022 20,4 ºC 8 de desembre del 2025 20,1 ºC 11 de desembre del 1915 20,0 ºC 1 de desembre del 1939 20,0 ºC L’11 de desembre del 1915 i l’1 de desembre del 1939 són els únics dos dies dels primers 100 anys de dades que han arribat als 20 ºC. També et pot interessar El 2025 es postula com el segon any més càlid després d’un novembre amb podi Marcos Amores Sánchez 2 minuts de lectura Al centre, més freqüent A la trama urbana, tot i que tampoc no és habitual superar els 20 ºC al desembre, el cert és que és molt més recurrent que no pas a l’Observatori Fabra. L’observatori de les Corts – Can Bruixa (Meteocat), amb dades des del 1987, conté una seixantena de registres de 20 ºC o més i amb una distribució molt més homogènia, per bé que també s’entreveu una concentració evident en els darrers cinc anys. De nou en destaca el 2022, amb set jornades en què la temperatura va arribar als 20 ºC. Curiosament, la màxima més alta en un desembre és encara del segle passat. articles.body: Novembre del 2001 ha quedat també en el record meteorològic de moltíssimes persones per ser una de les pitjors llevantades vistes mai a casa nostra. Aquesta, el temporal de Sant Esteve del 2008 i el temporal Gloria del 2020 són probablement les tres grans fites en aquest tipus de situació de la història més recent. Una irrupció d’aire polar com a desencadenant Dos dies abans del gran temporal de mar, un passadís perfectament format entre l’anticicló de l’Atlàntic i les borrasques del nord d’Itàlia i el Bàltic van comportar una irrupció d’aire fred d’origen polar que va arribar directament cap a casa nostra. Mapa sinòptic del dia 11 de novembre de 2001. Font: metoffice/wetterzentrale Aquest aire fred, en arribar a un mar Mediterrani que aleshores tenia una temperatura superior a l’habitual, va formar una profundíssima borrasca al sud-est de les illes Balears que va comportar un dels pitjors temporals marítims que es recorden a Barcelona . El dia 11, moment del màxim d’onatge, es van assolir onades properes als 10 m davant les costes de Barcelona i del delta de l’Ebre, i d’entre 12-14 metres a les illes Balears , on els aiguats (de més de 250 litres) i el temporal de mar també van causar desperfectes milionaris. Entre d’altres, la Base Nàutica, l’Escola de Vela, el Port Olímpic i totes les platges del litoral barceloní en van notar les conseqüències. En aquesta primera estocada del temporal es va calcular una pèrdua de prop d’un 60 % de la sorra de les platges i les més afectades van ser les del Bogatell, Sant Sebastià i la Barceloneta. Tres vehicles van caure al mar fruit del vent, que va bufar amb cops propers als 100 km/h, de gregal. Els rècords, el dia 15 Per si no n’havíem tingut prou, després de la primera embranzida del dia 11, la borrasca va fer l’intent de marxar cap a l’est, però va girar cua, alimentada per una nova descàrrega d’aire fred . El dia 15 de novembre del 2001 , la borrasca es va situar més a prop de casa nostra causant un dels pitjors temporals de vent mai registrats, fins al punt que molts rècords històrics de sèries de més de 50 anys de dades tenen el registre màxim de vent en aquell 15 de novembre del 2001. A l’aeroport del Prat, amb dades de vent des dels anys 60, es va registrar una ratxa de vent de 139 km/h , rècord històric de la sèrie per sobre, fins i tot, de l’episodi de vent del gener del 2009. El mateix passa a l’Observatori Fabra, on es van registrar 133 km/h , també rècord absolut de la sèrie, que en el cas del vent té dades fiables des de principis dels anys 90. Altres registres remarcables van ser els 110 km/h del centre de Barcelona o els 130 km/h de Badalona . I com gairebé passa en aquest tipus de situació, el vent més fort, el gregal. El llevant li posa nom (llevantada) però el vent que més fort bufa a Barcelona és el gregal. Arbres caiguts, sostres que van caure (com el de la facultat de periodisme), una desena de ferits  i una greu afectació al litoral i al trànsit (aeri i marítim) entre Barcelona i les Balears, van ser algunes de les incidències d’aquell excepcional episodi arribat en dos “tempos”. El temporal de mar, tot i que no tan important com el de només quatre dies abans, va acabar de malmetre un litoral ja molt castigat pocs dies abans. D’aquell episodi també destaca una nevada extraordinària al Montseny, on es van acumular prop de 35 cm de neu caiguda.
